title: Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Treaty stream - Ballot country status

sections.heading: Pacific Engagement visa - Treaty stream Country Ballot Status
sections.text:
The Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream ballot for Tuvalu nationals was open from 1 May 2026 to 1 June 2026.

The Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream Country Ballot Status table below provides details of the Treaty stream ballot. This includes the open and close period for submitting a registration and the status of the ballot.

We will conduct the ballot selection process during the selection period as outlined in the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream Country Ballot Status table below.

The ballot status may show as follows:

PENDING – The Ballot is pending commencement or opening.

Active – The Ballot is open and you can submit your registration.

CLOSED – The Ballot period for participants to submit registrations is closed. No further registrations can be submitted and the selection process is pending for this ballot.

EXPIRED – Selections have been finalised for this Ballot. No further selections will be made from this ballot.

Pacific Engagement visa - Treaty stream Country Ballot Status table
Country | Registration Open Date | Registration Close Date | Status
Tuvalu | 1 May 2026 | 1 June 2026 | CLOSED

sections.heading: Pacific Engagement visa - Treaty stream Country Ballot Status > Ballot Selection Period
sections.text:
The ballot selection process will begin after the ballot registration period is closed.

The table below shows the ballot selection period (open and close dates). This is when the random selection of registrations for the Tuvalu ballot happen.

Pacific Engagement visa - Treaty stream Ballot Selection Period table
Country | Selection
Tuvalu | 9 June 2026 to 30 June 2027

We expect to complete the first random selection process for the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Treaty stream ballot for Tuvalu when the selection period commences.

The department may make a further selection later in the program year to fill remaining country allocation.

If we select you in the ballot, we will email you with instructions on how to apply for a visa and the deadline to apply. Your status in ImmiAccount will show as ‘Selected’. If we do not select you in the ballot, your status in ImmiAccount will show as ‘Received’.

For more information, see
Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Treaty stream - After you register.

We will publish any further selection processes on the department’s website and social media when visa applications progress and as we fill allocations.
